# SkillUp-Web — Phase 03 Principal Architect Audit Report

**Audit date:** 2026-11-01
**Repository:** `skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC`
**Pinned source commit:** `e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c` (`feature/project-llm-linux-worker`)
**Mode:** Read-only static review; no builds, tests, credentials, DB queries, deployments or modifications performed.
**Phase objective:** Trace student onboarding, dashboard, batch enrollment, attendance, payments, placement, programs and faculty from application API into relevant data helpers; establish correctness, truthful empty/error states, and authorization dependencies.

## Re-audit update (2026-11-01)

This revision uses the earlier Phase 03 report as its historical findings baseline and independently cross-checks the principal student data helper, onboarding handlers, shared profile BFF, onboarding cookie, and end-user payments/assessment surfaces against pinned commit `e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c`. The previous review did not constitute runtime verification. No source changes, tests, DB access, deployments, or migrations were performed.

**Additional confirmed finding PH03-015:** Recording URLs are synthesized from session IDs without an asset lookup or entitlement validation in the inspected helper. In `apps/skillup-web/src/lib/skillup-data.ts` lines **302–308**, **340–346**, and **539–544**, a completed session receives `https://learn.skillupitacademy.com/recordings/${session.id}` even when its data query selected no recording asset. This can present nonexistent or inaccessible recordings as available. **Severity P2**, confirmed URL fabrication; actual access or link breakage is not runtime verified. Resolution requires a recording table/storage reference, entitlement check, and unavailable state.

**Further confirmed nuance:** The payments endpoint does filter SQL rows by `pp.user_id = $1` in `skillup-data.ts` lines **391–402**; ownership filtering is therefore present at this particular data-access query. This does not prove that the supplied `userId` corresponds to the payment database principal, which remains a Phase 02 identity-mapping dependency.

**Further confirmed nuance:** The end-user onboarding component posts to `/api/auth/onboarding` (`OnboardingPage.tsx` lines **24–42**) while the SkillUp-specific route reviewed is `/api/onboarding` (`apps/skillup-web/src/app/api/onboarding/route.ts` lines **12–68**). The exact `/api/auth/onboarding` implementation in shared/auth routing needs verification before calling this mismatch an execution failure.

## Executive decision

**Phase 03 static assessment report: delivered. Phase 03 exit criteria: NOT PASSED.** Multiple confirmed user-facing data-integrity defects remain in the pinned source; full backend/payment/placement ownership verification and tests are not completed. The audit must not be equated with remediation or production certification. Phase 04 should remain on hold if the agreed rule is to advance only after phase exit criteria are passed.

## Reviewed source inventory (principal files)

Application data and API: `apps/skillup-web/src/lib/skillup-data.ts` (624 lines), `src/lib/skillup-api.ts` (88), `src/app/api/onboarding/route.ts` (73), `src/app/api/onboarding/session/route.ts` (23), `src/app/api/profile/route.ts` (22), `src/app/api/student/dashboard/route.ts` (14), `src/app/api/student/attendance/route.ts` (14), `src/app/api/student/my-batch/route.ts` (14), `src/app/api/student/payments/route.ts` (14), `src/app/api/student/placement/route.ts` (14), `src/app/api/batches/route.ts` (14), `src/app/api/faculty/route.ts` (45), `src/app/api/programs/route.ts` (45), `src/app/api/programs/[slug]/route.ts` (62).

Related end-user pages and shared dependencies previously inspected and cross-referenced: `src/app/student/page.tsx`, `student/attendance/page.tsx`, `student/my-batch/page.tsx`, `student/payments/page.tsx`, `student/placement/page.tsx`, `student/exams/page.tsx`, `src/app/batches/page.tsx`, `src/app/programs/page.tsx`, `src/app/faculty/page.tsx`, `src/app/onboarding/page.tsx`, `src/app/placement/PlacementBridgeClient.tsx`, `src/share-branding/OnboardingEngine/components/OnboardingPage.tsx`, `src/share-branding/onboardingPageData.ts`, `src/share-branding/onboardingSessionCookie.ts`, `src/share-branding/auth/bffProfileHandler.ts`. App paths above are relative to `apps/skillup-web/`, unless beginning `src/share-branding/`.

**Coverage caveat:** The core 624-line data helper was fully retrieved in Round 13 and key paths were verified against the pinned commit here. This phase's evidence includes previous rounds' complete-source reviews and current selective cross-checks. It does not establish a fresh complete line-by-line re-review of every listed UI/backend dependency, so full integration certification is not claimed.

## Findings

### PH03-001 — P1 — Fake learner batch shown when no active enrollment (CONFIRMED)
- Source: `apps/skillup-web/src/lib/skillup-data.ts`, **88–107, 312–320, 512–517**.
- `getStudentBatchContext` returns null when no active enrollment; `getSkillupMyBatch()` and `getSkillupBatches()` return `FALLBACK_BATCH` instead of an explicit unenrolled state. The fallback includes faculty, sessions/materials and learner count.
- Consequence: Product reports nonexistent enrollment/classes as real. The `GET /api/student/my-batch` and `/api/batches` wrappers faithfully expose the fabricated response.
- Remediation: Return typed `not_enrolled`/empty state; distinguish DB outage from absent enrollment; render explicit CTA only when authorized.

### PH03-002 — P1 — Fabricated programs/faculty used on empty DB/errors (CONFIRMED)
- Source: `skillup-data.ts`, **37–87, 209–245, 548–589**.
- Program and faculty helpers fall back to hardcoded records; programs fallback occurs on empty result and in catch; faculty synthetic records and hero metrics are surfaced under failure/empty branches.
- Consequence: A learner sees invented offerings, faculty and statistics instead of accurate catalog or service error.
- Remediation: Remove production synthetic fallbacks; permit explicit demo-mode fixtures only; use typed empty/error responses.

### PH03-003 — P1/P2 — Synthetic placement readiness/interview counts and job matches (CONFIRMED)
- Source: `skillup-data.ts`, **109–123, 419–507**, notably **454, 464, 489, 501–506**.
- Interview count is derived from readiness score, and some job-match scores are generated from index/readiness rather than proven student-job matching. A hardcoded profile appears if no active record exists.
- Consequence: Learners receive misleading career guidance and fabricated activity metrics.
- Remediation: Derive interviews from actual interview records; return true matches or clearly label rankings as estimates with provenance; use a legitimate empty placement state.

### PH03-004 — P2 — Attendance numerator and denominator use different scopes (CONFIRMED)
- Source: `skillup-data.ts`, **265–280**.
- Present-count query aggregates attendance for the user across batches; denominator counts sessions for one selected active batch. Ratio can exceed 100%, and attendance may include irrelevant classes.
- Remediation: Filter numerator by the exact batch/session universe in denominator; avoid duplicate records; add zero-sessions and multi-batch tests.

### PH03-005 — P2 — Payment amounts from divergent sources / silent empty result (CONFIRMED)
- Source: `skillup-data.ts`, **248–274, 374–417**.
- Dashboard due amount uses `paymentInstallments` in the people DB; dedicated payments page uses an external payment DB query. If payment connection is absent, `getSkillupPayments` returns an empty list instead of misconfiguration error.
- Consequence: Payment due shown on dashboard may disagree with installments view; missing infrastructure can masquerade as paid/empty state.
- Remediation: Authoritative payment service and reconciliation contract; observable missing-DB error; tests for both endpoints for same learner.

### PH03-006 — P2 — Dashboard “placement matches” counts all open jobs (CONFIRMED)
- Source: `skillup-data.ts`, **294–300**.
- The count has no per-student match filter, despite UI label `Job matches` in `src/app/student/page.tsx`.
- Remediation: Join to matching results for authenticated student or relabel as `Open opportunities`.

### PH03-007 — P2 — Onboarding completion and skip redirect even after failed persistence (CONFIRMED)
- Source: `src/share-branding/OnboardingEngine/components/OnboardingPage.tsx`, **24–42, 67–113**.
- In both catch blocks an error is logged but router still navigates to `/dashboard`.
- Consequence: Failed saves appear successful; subsequent server redirect may loop/return to onboarding.
- Remediation: Preserve state, show error and retry; navigate only on verified success.

### PH03-008 — P2 — Onboarding BFF and client paths require end-to-end contract validation (CONDITIONAL)
- Source: `apps/skillup-web/src/app/api/onboarding/route.ts`, **20–68**; `OnboardingPage.tsx`, **24–42**.
- BFF maps `POST /api/onboarding` to gateway `/auth/onboarding` with `createInternalHeaders`; client submits `/api/auth/onboarding`. Verify actual gateway/Next auth proxy routing rather than assuming both are equivalent. The BFF chooses gateway URL from substring `hostname.includes('skillup')`; this is a fragile alternative to canonical brand resolution.
- Remediation: One documented route and canonical host/brand resolution; integration test client->BFF->gateway->backend->DB.

### PH03-009 — P2 — Unauthenticated onboarding-session endpoint stores client-provided journey state (CONFIRMED endpoint; downstream impact conditional)
- Source: `apps/skillup-web/src/app/api/onboarding/session/route.ts`, **8–22**; `src/share-branding/onboardingSessionCookie.ts`.
- Request sets HttpOnly cookie based on parsed client payload without authentication. It must not be treated as authoritative backend completion proof. `onboardingPageData.ts` uses it for form seeding; full set of other consumers must be verified.
- Remediation: Treat cookie as untrusted draft only; server-authoritative onboarding gate; explicit TTL and integrity strategy if used for decisions.

### PH03-010 — P2 — Program curriculum generated from marketing highlights (CONFIRMED)
- Source: `skillup-data.ts`, **594–624**.
- Detail helper constructs generic curricular sections instead of reading actual learning modules and published curriculum.
- Consequence: Program detail may promise content not tied to the course structure.
- Remediation: Use published curriculum records and represent missing curriculum as empty/unpublished.

### PH03-011 — P2 — Dashboard visual bars are hard-coded while values are dynamic (CONFIRMED)
- Source: `apps/skillup-web/src/app/student/page.tsx`, **around 78–103**.
- Attendance/progress/upcoming/job bars use fixed class widths (`86%`, `68%`, `54%`, `62%`) regardless of displayed values.
- Remediation: Compute proportional widths from actual bounded values; use appropriate scales for counts.

### PH03-012 — P2 — Exam/payments calls to action not functional (CONFIRMED)
- Source: `apps/skillup-web/src/app/student/exams/page.tsx` and `src/app/student/payments/page.tsx`.
- Static assessment tracks have `Start practice` buttons without handlers; payments page `Pay overdue installment` and `Download receipt` buttons have no implemented actions.
- Remediation: Wire authorized workflows, or disable clearly and remove misleading status claims.

### PH03-013 — P2 — SSR fallback masks program/faculty authentication or upstream failure (CONFIRMED)
- Source: `apps/skillup-web/src/lib/skillup-api.ts`, **55–87**.
- If programs or faculty HTTP fetch fails for any reason, SSR helper calls direct data service. Protected learner routes appropriately throw instead.
- Consequence: Service/authorization failures can be masked with data fallback; behavior differs across page categories.
- Remediation: Distinguish unauthorized, unavailable and genuine empty; only use direct DB helpers when explicitly allowed by architecture.

### PH03-014 — P2 — Attendance list record identity uses display dates (CONFIRMED risk)
- Source: `apps/skillup-web/src/app/student/attendance/page.tsx`.
- React list uses `entry.date` as key; duplicate classes on the same date collide. Attendance representation only includes formatted date/status/note, losing unique session/record ID.
- Remediation: Include stable attendance ID and scheduled session timestamp; group multiple sessions clearly.

### PH03-015 — P2 — Synthetic recording links without asset verification (CONFIRMED)
- Source: `apps/skillup-web/src/lib/skillup-data.ts`, **302–308, 340–346, 539–544**.
- A completed session is assigned a URL computed from its ID, regardless of actual recording existence or learner access.
- Consequence: Learners can be shown recordings that do not exist or to which they have no entitlement.
- Remediation: Store verified recording asset IDs/URLs, check publishing/access state, and show `recording unavailable` where applicable.

## Positive controls
- Student API endpoints call `requireStudentAuth` and pass its resolved user ID to data helpers. This does not by itself prove the downstream identity mapping but avoids direct user ID from client query.
- Programs/faculty route handlers perform their own authentication and brand validation.
- The dedicated content-manager source-file writer endpoint returns HTTP 410 and is not available for learner editing.
- SSR learner API helper fails rather than using fake data when protected student API request fails.

## Unverified dependencies / missing tests
1. Gateway `/auth/onboarding` mapping, server-side authenticated persistence and brand-specific DB transaction semantics.
2. Student user-ID mapping (`shadowUserId` vs `originalUserId`) to people, payment and placement databases (Phase 02 carryover).
3. Payment ownership, tenant scoping, schema/version and transaction reconciliation across payment DB and people DB.
4. Placement ranking algorithm inputs, profile ownership and interview-count source of truth.
5. Program/subject/batch classification and published curriculum/availability policies.
6. Attendance semantics for multiple sessions, late arrivals, reschedules and deleted sessions.
7. Cross-tenant and malformed input regression tests and actual CI/build/test results.

# SUIA Marketing — Phase 04 Principal Architect Findings Consolidation Report

**Date:** 2026-11-01
**Repository:** `skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC`
**Pinned source commit:** `5efd1129d905d05c912acfef66e52df9ca15120b`

## Executive assessment

The Phase 03 assessment contains **eight source-backed integration findings (P03-01–P03-08)**. They resolve to **six root-cause families**, not eight independent root causes. Several are connected to existing MKT IDs (especially MKT-223, MKT-228, MKT-285, MKT-286); others have **no proven canonical MKT mapping**. Phase 01 and Phase 02 supplied evidence classifications and partial source review, not a full text register of MKT-001–286. Thus a 286-entry item-by-item deduplication, closure state, and fix validation **cannot be certified**. **Do not infer that 286 issues remain open or that any is resolved.**

The principal architectural blockers for source-level sign-off are provider consent enforcement, brand-scoped tracker isolation, durable delivery and truthful acknowledgement, and conflict-safe identity resolution. All deployment/runtime claims remain qualified until validated in integration testing.

## Scope, inputs and evidence boundaries

Read `Phase01_Marketing_Coverage_Audit_Report.md`, `Phase01_Marketing_Evidence_Summary.json`, `Phase02_Marketing_Source_Audit_Report.md`, `Phase02_Marketing_290_File_Review_Tracker.csv`, `Phase03_Marketing_Integration_Security_Audit_Report.md`, `FinalAechitecture.md`, `ProjectAuditReport.md`, and `ResolveProjectAuditReport.md`. Phase 01 inventory: 290 source files; 106 pinned-retrieved, 45 historical-report-only, 139 no mapped path evidence. Phase 02: 20 additional pinned source files retrieved; at least 126 with pinned-source retrieval evidence. **Retrieval evidence is not complete line-by-line certification.** The historical master MKT register containing each ID's full canonical description, owner, fix commit and test result is not supplied in these documents. The counts represent historical audit IDs, not a validated live defect population.

No production deployment, tests, database, pipeline runtime, network delivery, or remediation branch was executed here. Phase 03 source excerpts and exact line references are the authoritative source-level evidence for the eight entries; listed architecture documents express desired design, not deployed reality.

## Consolidation methodology

1. Maintain immutable source and independent stable Phase-03 identifiers. No automatic new MKT-287+ IDs.
2. Group by independently correctable **root cause**, not by occurrence count or file count.
3. Preserve distinct failure modes as testable subcases under one root family where applicable.
4. Link existing MKT IDs **only** where preceding reports explicitly establish relevant overlap; mark adjacent/not-equivalent cases rather than silently merging.
5. Assign **source-confirmed**, **conditional**, and **runtime-unverified** statuses separately; never infer remediation status from audit documentation.
6. Block release approval where a high-severity integrity/consent/security issue is not remediated and retested.

## Root-cause families and decisions

| Root cause | Related findings | Severity | Consolidation | Release implication |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **RC-01 Consent enforcement** | P03-01 server; P03-07 direct browser APIs | High | One family, two independent bypass paths | **Blocker candidate** |
| **RC-02 Tenant/brand isolation** | P03-02 singleton | High | Distinct from identity scoping | **Blocker candidate** |
| **RC-03 Delivery reliability** | P03-03 server; P03-08 client | High | Shared delivery family with independent per-provider subcases; MKT-223/228 adjacent | **Blocker candidate** |
| **RC-04 Identity merge correctness** | P03-04 | High | Conflicting merge and missing namespace; MKT-226 hashed-data issue is adjacent, **not necessarily duplicate** | **Blocker candidate** |
| **RC-05 Consent storage/schema** | P03-05 | Medium/High | Storage exceptions overlap MKT-285; invalid schema remains distinct acceptance test | Must fix |
| **RC-06 Persistent preference UX** | P03-06 | Medium/High | Provisional until site-wide launcher is checked | Verify and correct if absent |

### Detailed findings and remediation acceptance

- **Source evidence:** `lib/analytics/tracker.ts:145-159; lib/privacy/consent-manager.ts:52-63; lib/analytics/server/route.ts:14-31; lib/analytics/server/pipeline.ts:261-266`

- **Evidence qualification:** Source-confirmed enforcement gap; jurisdictional applicability untested.

These historical IDs have concrete references in prior round summaries, but **were not included in a complete canonical MKT register**; preserve them for Phase 04 follow-up rather than assigning final status:

## Remediation ordering and release gates

**Priority A — block source-level approval:** (1) server/client consent policy and negative tests (RC-01); (2) brand-keyed analytics tracker and cross-brand tests (RC-02); (3) durable event outbox/queue, provider `response.ok`, idempotency, replay and failure transparency (RC-03); (4) conflict-safe and brand-aware identity policy (RC-04). Each needs a reviewed fix commit plus automated failure-mode evidence. These are **blocker candidates pending owner triage**, not evidence that a release currently occurred.

**Priority B — before production approval:** (5) fail-closed runtime consent schema and storage adapter (RC-05); (6) persistent preference UI verification (RC-06); (7) eliminate `innerHTML` fallback, fix major accessibility/navigation defects, ensure course claims match verified source of truth and test animations/CTAs.

**Priority C — audit governance:** obtain the complete 286-item historical findings register, assign each old ID a canonical title/source/evidence, root-cause family, severity, owner, fix commit, test evidence and disposition; reconcile phase 03 with that register. Repeat against the intended release commit; the pinned snapshot is not necessarily the release branch.

| MKT-001–286 exhaustively reconciled | **FAIL** | Historical canonical per-ID register not available |
| Fix status and current code retested | **NOT VERIFIED** | No remediation commit or test evidence supplied |
| Production approval | **WITHHELD** | High-severity source-level blockers and missing tests |

## Phase 05 handoff

1. Obtain canonical MKT-001–286 export and remediation tracker, then create exact one-row-per-ID crosswalk with duplicate-parent pointers; do not invent old text or fix states.
2. Require reviewed corrective commits and explicit acceptance artifacts for RC-01–RC-05, plus site-wide consent preference validation for RC-06.

5. Deliver conditional architecture risk report. **No unconditional production sign-off** absent these gates.

# Phase C — Principal Architect Audit: Current Block-Based Tutorial Experience

**Audit date:** 2026-11-01
**Repository:** `skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC`
**Branch:** `feature/project-llm-linux-worker`
**Mode:** Read-only GitHub source inspection. No builds, automated tests, browser tests or edits.

## Executive decision

**Phase C audit report delivered; Phase C cannot be certified complete or accepted.** The authenticated ILS block APIs and core block-resolution dependencies were inspected, as were the currently identified learner tutorial dashboard, its route, and BFF entry points. The canonical client-side block renderer and block-interaction hook/component tree were not reliably discoverable using the available private-repository code-search interface (empty results for relevant symbols); therefore neither complete UI coverage nor a 50–60-file full line-by-line review can be represented as achieved. The outstanding file inventory and browser verification are mandatory before Phase C sign-off. **Next phase on hold.**

## Explicit scope boundary

IN: block-based `TutorialDocument.blocks[]`, versioned block completion/visit/time events, ILS API routes, progress calculations, RTH tutorial dashboard and user-facing current-content BFF boundaries.

OUT: legacy section/subsection interaction implementations (`apps/api-server/src/app/api/tutorial/interactions/{code,quiz,practice,visual,completion}`), deprecated `apps/realtutorialhub-web/src/app/api/tutorial/content/[subtopicId]/route.ts`, and the static Python sample lesson at `src/share-branding/LearningExperience/TutorialPage.tsx` used by `/learning-path`. The sample was opened only to establish that it hard-codes Python course data and is not evidence of the canonical `TutorialDocument.blocks[]` renderer; its 1,188 lines were **not audited**.

## Confirmed findings

### C-01 — High — Canonical lookup conflates missing content with zero required blocks
- `packages/db-tutorial/src/services/learning-progress.hierarchy-resolution.ts:54–64`: absent section/content/blocks returns `[]`.
- `packages/db-tutorial/src/services/learning-progress.aggregation.ts:102–114` (approximately; exact code near `calculateProgressPercentage`): zero requirements gives 100%.
- Combined with node completion, missing or malformed content may be evaluated as vacuously complete (dependent on the independent hierarchy validation); unlike an intentionally published informational page, this should fail closed.
- **Fix:** distinguish `CONTENT_NOT_FOUND`, invalid document, and genuine empty instructional requirements; authorize empty instructional pages explicitly, and test each case.

### C-02 — High — Brand-specific canonical page lookup lacks deterministic precedence
- `packages/db-tutorial/src/repositories/tutorial-section.repository.ts:120–146` selects requested brand OR `shared`, then `.limit(1)` without explicit order. This same method feeds `resolveRequiredBlocks` and `validateNavigationHierarchy`, so the chosen brand document can affect progress and content identity.
- **Fix:** order exact brand first, then shared, require deployed/active status where appropriate; test multiple matching records and different block versions.

### C-03 — High — Tutorial dashboard presents static demonstration learning metrics as live progress
- `apps/realtutorialhub-web/src/app/tutorial/page.tsx:10–14` builds dashboard data with `buildTutorialDashboardData(rthConfig)`.
- `src/share-branding/tutorialDashboardData.ts:106–253` hard-codes learner name, streak, XP, progress, assignments, projects and career-readiness values.
- `src/share-branding/TutorialDashboard/components/LearningProgressOverview.tsx:7–13, 51–89` displays those values.
- **Fix:** replace sample data with authenticated, brand- and user-scoped backend data, or clearly identify demonstration mode; do not silently substitute fabricated statistics.

### C-04 — Medium — Current dashboard UI advertises actions without handlers
- `src/share-branding/TutorialDashboard/TutorialEngineDashboardPage.tsx:83–100` AI tutor support button lacks handler/navigation.
- `src/share-branding/TutorialDashboard/components/LearningProgressOverview.tsx:43–49, 98–109` filter and analytics buttons lack handlers/navigation.
- `src/share-branding/TutorialDashboard/components/AssignmentsWidget.tsx` and `ProjectsWidget.tsx` show View All buttons without navigation; only assignment tab state changes.
- **Fix:** implement actions or mark the controls disabled/coming soon; add keyboard and navigation tests.

### C-05 — Medium — Progress repository uses unbounded recursive retry after uniqueness conflict
- `packages/db-tutorial/src/repositories/tutorial-navigation-progress.repository.ts:278–281` and `447–450`: after `ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, it fetches progress then recursively calls `markBlockCompleted(event)` or `recordTime(event)`; under pathological repeat-conflict conditions there is no explicit retry bound.
- **Fix:** switch to bounded iterative retry or a single atomic SQL upsert with conflict handling, plus contention tests. This is a resilience risk rather than proof of an infinite loop under ordinary operation.

### C-06 — Medium — RTH content BFF logs authenticated identifiers and cookie names
- `apps/realtutorialhub-web/src/app/api/tutorial/sections/[subtopicId]/route.ts:17–35` logs cookie names and full authenticated `userId`; further logs response and upstream error metadata.
- **Fix:** limit to structured, redacted operational diagnostics, redact IDs, and avoid cookie enumeration in production logging.

### C-07 — High — Current tutorial section BFF passes arbitrary incoming query parameters downstream
- `apps/realtutorialhub-web/src/app/api/tutorial/sections/[subtopicId]/route.ts:38–47` copies all `searchParams` to the upstream URL; `:49–57` uses a signed internal header and an authenticated `userId`.
- **Fix:** permit-list allowed filters (e.g. page identity, locale) and confirm upstream independently derives brand and user from verified internal trust. Arbitrary params are a potential unsafe selector only if upstream trusts them; **security exploitation not established** by this review.

### C-08 — Medium — Block-centric UI integration cannot be certified from current source inventory
- The reviewed source proves ILS server endpoints are present, but does not establish which modern block renderer owns visits, completion, time tracking, loading, retries, or session identity. The `/learning-path` route points to a static Python example, not that canonical renderer.
- **Fix:** inventory actual imported block page/component and hooks using a repository tree, review every reachable file line-by-line, and run browser-level tests. This is a **coverage blocker**, not a claimed source defect.

## Positive controls confirmed in inspected code

- `apps/api-server/src/app/api/tutorial/ils/{block-completion,block-visit,block-active-time,active-time,visit,complete-node}/route.ts` use `validateRequest(... { requireInternalSecret: true })`, and derive user and brand from validated context.
- `apps/api-server/src/schemas/ils.schemas.ts` does not accept client-provided `userId`, `brand` or `requiredBlocks` in the canonical completion payloads.
- Block time events use a UUID `eventId` in the input schema, and the block-time endpoint surfaces `processed` / `alreadyProcessed`.
- `learning-progress.hierarchy-resolution.ts` excludes structural, assessment, and media blocks from required instructional progress using `progressRole` (subject to correct role annotation).
- `tutorial-navigation-progress.repository.ts` uses DB conflict handling and atomic increment helpers in major persistence paths.

# SUIA Marketing — Phase 05 Final Architectural Audit Assessment

**Assessment date:** 2026-11-01
**Principal Architect disposition:** **NO-GO / NOT APPROVED FOR PRODUCTION RELEASE**
**Assessment state:** **Phase 05 report complete; overall audit closure NOT certified**
**Repository:** `skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC`
**Immutable commit:** `5efd1129d905d05c912acfef66e52df9ca15120b`
**Marketing source subtree:** `packages/marketing-site/src/`
**Tree SHA:** `a1753abdf166364bdc76c55df6ed33e1a014a8c4`
**Source tree size:** **290 Git blobs**

## 1. Executive decision

The five-phase review has produced a verified inventory, partial pinned-source inspection records, an integration and security assessment, and a bounded root-cause consolidation. **There is insufficient evidence to certify complete source coverage, full remediation, runtime resilience, or production readiness.** High-impact, source-supported issues in consent governance, brand-specific tracking, event delivery, and identity merge safety remain **unverified as fixed** at the audited commit. This is a *source-level architectural no-go*, not evidence that a deployed site was breached or that any particular external provider actually received prohibited data.

**Verdict: retain release hold.** Do not issue a final clean audit certificate or claim 'all 290 files audited line by line.'

## 2. Evidence provenance and numeric reconciliation

- Phase 01 verified exactly **290 unique file paths** and classified evidence as **106 pinned-source retrieved**, **45 historical-report mention only**, **139 no path-level evidence**. These classes measure *evidence*, not whether software works or whether a human has ever read the files.
- Phase 02 retrieved another **20 distinct targeted files**, totaling **1,113 lines**, bringing the **conservative floor to 126/290 pinned-source retrieval evidence**, leaving **164 without pinned-source retrieval evidence in that tracker**. The later Phase 03 and prior-round inspections may overlap; the conservative ledger is **not** a complete cumulative retrospective of every source-fetch action.
- The historical ledger records **MKT-001 through MKT-286 (286 IDs)**; this is not a verified count of still-open unique defects. The canonical item-by-item master with fix commits and retest results was not established.
- Phase 03 documented **8 integration findings (P03-01–P03-08)**. Phase 04 consolidated them into **6 root-cause families**; neither the eight nor six should be indiscriminately added to the 286 historical IDs.
- No reproducible build, lint, typecheck, unit, browser E2E, staging, deployed endpoint, provider delivery or recovery test results were supplied in the phase reports.

## 3. Highest-priority architectural concerns

| Priority | Family | Evidence | Source-level impact | Minimum remediation gate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| P0 / release hold | RC-01 Consent enforcement | P03-01, P03-07; `lib/analytics/tracker.ts:145-159`, `lib/analytics/server/route.ts:14-31`, `lib/analytics/server/pipeline.ts:261-266` | Browser flush is consent-gated but the observed server ingestion and direct-provider paths are not equivalently gated | Trusted server-side consent validation and direct-call negative tests, including revocation and expiry |
| P0 / release hold | RC-02 Brand isolation | P03-02; `lib/analytics/tracker.ts:197-229` | Singleton tracker creation is not keyed to the brand argument, so two-brand usage of the same module can reuse the wrong configuration | Brand-keyed instances or proven isolation, plus two-brand tests |
| P0 / release hold | RC-03 Delivery integrity | P03-03, P03-08; `lib/analytics/server/pipeline.ts:249-275,327-335`, `lib/analytics/tracker.ts:145-175` | Failures can be recorded without surfacing final failure to caller; durability/replay not demonstrated | Provider response validation, durable retries, observable outcome and idempotent replay |
| P0 / release hold | RC-04 Identity correctness | P03-04; `lib/analytics/identity/user-merge-engine.ts:19-45`, `identity-store.ts:20-41` | Merge conflicts are collected but the merge proceeds; brand namespace not evident in map key | Reject/quarantine conflicts, deterministic controls, brand-scoped keys and tests |
| P1 | RC-05 Consent storage | P03-05; `lib/privacy/consent-storage.ts:10-27` | Raw storage/JSON cast lacks complete exception safety and runtime shape validation | Schema validation, guarded read/write, fail-closed fallback and malformed-data tests |

**Important:** Risk priorities are architectural triage recommendations, not a formal CVSS assessment or tested exploit severity. Confirm actual deployment topology and data paths before asserting externally observable harm.

## 6. Required engineering and verification package

1. **Evidence recovery:** Complete a canonical 290-row source review ledger with path, blob SHA, full-source reviewer result, relevant tests, findings and acceptance decision. Prioritize the 164 not pinned-retrieved in the conservative Phase 02 register, but reconcile subsequent valid pinned evidence to avoid waste.
2. **Fix candidates:** Address RC-01 to RC-04 before release. Include implementation diffs and owner approvals; revise source-of-truth expectations where behavior is deliberate.
3. **Consent matrix:** Exercise essential-only, analytics-only, full grant, revoke, expiry, invalid saved state, blocked storage, direct endpoint POST and direct provider APIs. Prove no unauthorized provider dispatch.
4. **Two-brand isolation:** Run both brands within a shared runtime and isolated runtimes; prove correct configuration, stable IDs, event labeling, identity scope and absence of cross-brand leakage.
5. **Failure and recovery:** Test provider HTTP 4xx/5xx, timeout, partial success, burst, process restart, queue capacity, dead-letter replay, and duplicate suppression. Verify acknowledgement semantics.
6. **Identity integrity:** Test conflicting email/user/CRM IDs, anonymous-to-authenticated transitions, existing merge chains and brand collisions.
7. **Content and UX:** Validate all 12 course duration/assessment claims against approved data; check navigation, keyboard controls, image fallbacks and certificate-preview claims.
8. **CI proof:** Attach build, typecheck, lint, unit, integration, accessibility and end-to-end outputs for the exact release commit, along with reproducible commands and environment configuration.
9. **Closure proof:** For all 286 historical MKT IDs, retain source evidence, duplicate/supersession mapping, remediation commit, tests, reviewer, disposition and closure date. Any residual risk needs documented accountable acceptance.

## 7. Assurance boundaries

- This document assesses a **pinned historical source commit**, not today's moving `main`, an unpublished patch or a deployed environment.
- Source inspections from previous rounds do **not** independently prove complete per-line semantic audit of every file.
- Architecture specification files (`FinalAechitecture.md`, `ProjectAuditReport.md`, `ResolveProjectAuditReport.md`) describe desired design and historical issues; they are not substitute evidence of a fix.
- No changes to the GitHub repository, production data or infrastructure are represented by this audit.
- **Phase 05 submission is not equivalent to project acceptance or deployment authorization.**

## 8. Formal assessment statement

**Decision:** **NO-GO / HOLD RELEASE.**
**Reason:** unresolved high-risk source-level integration behavior, incomplete whole-tree review certification, incomplete historical finding closure evidence, and absent runtime validation.
**Reassessment trigger:** engineering submits fixes at a new pinned commit, completed evidence registers, and independently repeatable successful verification for all mandatory gates.
**Sign-off:** Principal Architect *assessment issued*; production sign-off **WITHHELD**. This is not a claim of human security attestation or completed runtime certification.

# SkillUp-Web — Phase 04 Principal Architect Audit

**Scope:** Tutorial V2, published navigation/content, client rendering, session tracking, ILS and legacy progress endpoints.
**Repository:** `skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC`
**Source pin:** `e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c` (`feature/project-llm-linux-worker` at the selected audit baseline)
**Method:** Read-only GitHub source retrieval, end-to-end call-path tracing and selective full-file inspection. No runtime tests, browser E2E, builds, migrations or changes performed.

## Executive decision

**Phase 04 static assessment delivered; Phase 04 is NOT certified complete / production-ready.** Confirmed high-risk authorization defects in the legacy progress API and a known incomplete sidebar-completion mapping remain. ILS backend code contains positive secret verification and Zod schemas. Service/repository-level transaction, tenant and resource-relation checks were not comprehensively verified in this review; these are formal exit gaps, not assumed safe.

## Call path reviewed

1. `apps/skillup-web/src/app/tutorial-v2/[domainSlug]/[subjectSlug]/[topicSlug]/[subtopicSlug]/[navigationNodeId]/page.tsx` checks token-cookie presence and extracts proxy-provided learner ID; `resolveRuntimeContext` loads published page payload and canonical URL.
2. `src/share-branding/LearningExperience/tutorialSidebarDelivery.ts` resolves hierarchy, selects published sidebar, validates exact navigation node, and invokes tutorial delivery service.
3. `src/share-branding/LearningExperience/components/TutorialPageShell.tsx` initializes tab session, drives ILS UI/telemetry, and attempts to load progress.
4. `src/share-branding/LearningExperience/runtime/tutorialTrackingService.ts` posts visits and block completion to SkillUp BFF; legacy GET progress is separate.
5. SkillUp `app/api/tutorial/ils/*/route.ts` proxies to shared API; newer API endpoints validate internal service secret, parsed request body and user scope.
6. Legacy `apps/skillup-web/src/app/api/tutorial/progress/route.ts` proxies to `apps/api-server/src/app/api/tutorial/progress/route.ts`, which accepts identity from request headers without its own authentication validation.

## Detailed findings

### PH04-001 — P1 — Legacy progress API trusts caller-provided `x-user-id` without verifying internal identity

**Confirmed source behavior.** `apps/api-server/src/app/api/tutorial/progress/route.ts` lines 28–49 obtains `x-brand` and `x-user-id` directly from headers; lines 57–80 (GET) and 115–153 (POST) use those values to query or update progress. Unlike the ILS routes, this handler does not invoke `validateRequest`, `getAuthContext`, or JWT verification. Authentication may exist at a separate gateway, but the handler does not enforce it, so directly reachable deployments or incorrectly configured routing expose an identity-spoofing risk.

**Remediation:** require a validated trusted service context at the handler; reject direct unverified identity headers; enforce user and brand in repository queries; test GET and POST with forged headers and absent/incorrect internal credentials.

[Source](https://github.com/skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC/blob/e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c/apps/api-server/src/app/api/tutorial/progress/route.ts#L28-L153)

### PH04-002 — P1/P2 — Tutorial dashboard sidebar completion remains an intentional no-op

**Confirmed.** `TutorialPageShell.tsx` lines 205–242 fetches legacy subtopic progress but explicitly creates an empty `Set<string>` of completed URLs because the legacy completion model is incompatible with navigation-node IDs. Thus navigation markers do not recover from persisted block-type progress. This is documented by TODO comments in source, not an inference.

**Remediation:** use ILS navigation-progress GET keyed by validated `navigationNodeId` and subtopic ID, map results to leaf URLs/IDs, and test reload, multi-tab and student isolation.

[Source](https://github.com/skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC/blob/e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c/src/share-branding/LearningExperience/components/TutorialPageShell.tsx#L205-L242)

### PH04-003 — P1 conditional — Rendered tutorial HTML lacks visible sanitizer at component boundaries

**Confirmed unsafe sink; exploitability conditional.** `TutorialCodeContent.tsx` lines 13–14, 119, 180; `TutorialSummaryContent.tsx` lines 9–10, 50, 86, 94, 115; `MarkdownRenderer.tsx` lines 240–243 pass content into `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`. The complete authoring/publishing sanitizer and CSP were not verified here. No actual injection exploit is claimed.

**Remediation:** use centrally allowlisted server-side sanitization and validate sanitization at publishing and display; include stored-XSS regression cases and CSP review.

[Code renderer](https://github.com/skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC/blob/e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c/src/share-branding/LearningExperience/components/TutorialCodeContent.tsx#L115-L120) | [Summary renderer](https://github.com/skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC/blob/e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c/src/share-branding/LearningExperience/components/TutorialSummaryContent.tsx#L45-L52) | [Markdown renderer](https://github.com/skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC/blob/e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c/src/share-branding/LearningExperience/components/MarkdownRenderer.tsx#L239-L244)

### PH04-004 — P2 — ILS BFF URL and internal-auth headers are inconsistent

**Confirmed.** SkillUp progress BFF normalizes base and calls `/api/tutorial/progress`, while visit, block completion and navigation routes call `/tutorial/ils/...` without base normalization; `complete-node` calls `/api/tutorial/ils/...`. Navigation BFF only forwards `X-Internal-Secret`, whereas other ILS BFFs add `x-internal-key`. The actual deployment base may intentionally differ, but route behavior remains configuration-dependent.

**Remediation:** one validated upstream base/URL builder; canonical path contract; integration tests under base URL ending both with and without `/api`.

[Navigation BFF](https://github.com/skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC/blob/e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c/apps/skillup-web/src/app/api/tutorial/ils/navigation/%5BnodeId%5D/route.ts#L37-L48) | [Progress BFF](https://github.com/skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC/blob/e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c/apps/skillup-web/src/app/api/tutorial/progress/route.ts#L39-L52)

### PH04-005 — P2 — Legacy progress and ILS navigation progress have divergent identity models

**Confirmed.** Legacy progress stores block-type completion by user/subtopic. New ILS routes use exact navigation node, subtopic, optional section, block ID/version and session. `TutorialPageShell`'s documented inability to map one to the other demonstrates they are not equivalent. A migration/adapter is needed; do not merge silently.

[Legacy schema](https://github.com/skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC/blob/e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c/apps/api-server/src/app/api/tutorial/progress/route.ts#L20-L26) | [ILS schemas](https://github.com/skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC/blob/e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c/apps/api-server/src/schemas/ils.schemas.ts)

### PH04-006 — P2 — Tracking failures are intentionally nonfatal, but completion UX needs authoritative acknowledgment

**Confirmed design decision; downstream consequence requires E2E verification.** `tutorialTrackingService.ts` catches errors and returns `{delivered:false}`; its code also treats a nonpersisted event category as delivered. Whether visible completion badges require persistence depends on ILS UI package behavior not yet comprehensively reviewed.

**Remediation:** distinguish client-handled, queued, persisted and failed events; show sync/error state for persisted progress; retry with idempotency keys.

[Source](https://github.com/skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC/blob/e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c/src/share-branding/LearningExperience/runtime/tutorialTrackingService.ts#L68-L194)

### PH04-007 — P2 — Progress calculation lacks defensive normalization

**Confirmed helper behavior.** `calculatePageProgress` uses `completedBlocks.length / totalBlocks` and equality to determine completion. It does not itself deduplicate block IDs, clamp percentages, or handle `totalBlocks = 0` when nonempty completion data is supplied. Safety may depend on caller invariants.

**Remediation:** explicitly define zero-total behavior, deduplicate IDs, intersect completed IDs with required IDs, clamp result to 0–100, and test invalid/duplicate inputs.

[Source](https://github.com/skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC/blob/e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c/src/share-branding/LearningExperience/runtime/tutorialTrackingService.ts#L310-L325)

### PH04-008 — P2 — Tracking session identity is browser-controlled metadata, not an authorization principal

**Confirmed.** Learning-session IDs are in `sessionStorage`, generated on the client and transmitted in request data/headers. `tutorialSessionService.ts` falls back to `Math.random` if secure random UUID is missing. The ILS API derives user/brand from authenticated internal context, which is a positive boundary. Ensure session values are never used as ownership evidence.

[Session service](https://github.com/skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC/blob/e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c/src/share-branding/LearningExperience/runtime/tutorialSessionService.ts#L44-L65)

### PH04-009 — P2 investigation — Published sidebar shared-first selection and hierarchy relation checks

`tutorialSidebarDelivery.ts` lines 391–438 selects a published shared sidebar before brand-specific records, and lines 449–500 validate exact node ID before loading content. The shared-first behavior may be intended for cross-brand published content. Verify the selected tree's subject/hierarchy ownership, tenant visibility and learner entitlement, and test that a valid node from a different subtopic cannot be used to fetch unrelated content.

[Source](https://github.com/skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC/blob/e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c/src/share-branding/LearningExperience/tutorialSidebarDelivery.ts#L391-L500)

## Positive controls seen

- Newer ILS `visit`, `block-completion` and navigation routes use `validateRequest(..., {requireInternalSecret:true})` and reject failed authentication before processing bodies.
- ILS routes parse request schemas through Zod (`ils.schemas.ts`) instead of accepting every arbitrary object.
- The Tutorial V2 page checks for an access-token cookie and requires a proxy-provided learner ID before resolving learner content, with exact navigation-node validation in the delivery layer. This check relies on the authenticated proxy and is not a substitute for backend ownership verification.
- `TutorialPageShell` intentionally renders empty content states without treating unpublished blocks as fatal.

## Reviewed source and coverage honesty

**Core source retrieved:** Tutorial V2 page; `tutorialSidebarDelivery.ts`; runtime resolver/session/tracking; page shell; legacy and ILS BFF routes; corresponding selected shared API handlers; ILS schemas; HTML renderer components. Evidence includes line-numbered ranges and a number of full source files. However, several long files were queried for relevant regions only, so a claim that *every line of every upstream tutorial service, repository, UI package, and migration* has been reviewed is unsupported.

**Still outstanding for complete Phase 04 closure:** whole-file review of `LearningProgressService`, `TutorialNavigationProgressRepository`, tutorial delivery service, instructional completion orchestrator and `@quiz/ui` ILS provider internals; cross-tenant/ownership tests; stored-XSS tests; real DB persistence/reload/replay checks; URL/secret contract integration tests; authoritative progress migration decision.

## Exit checklist

| Criterion | Result |
|---|---|
| Tutorial V2 route and page-runtime chain traced | Reviewed |
| Published sidebar/navigation and content path examined | Reviewed, entitlement details pending |
| Legacy progress identity authorization validated | **Fail: PH04-001** |
| Sidebar completion driven by persisted node progress | **Fail: PH04-002** |
| HTML content sanitization established | Not verified |
| ILS API auth, schemas checked | Positive controls verified on inspected endpoints |
| Persistence, concurrency, cross-brand isolation independently verified | Pending |
| Browser/E2E, DB, integration and regression tests run | Not performed |
| Production / complete phase sign-off | **Not approved** |

## Recommended remediation sequence

1. Secure legacy progress endpoint with mandatory verified principal and explicit user/brand ownership; add forged-header tests.
2. Replace sidebar completion no-op with authoritative navigation progress and define legacy data migration.
3. Validate HTML sanitization and add security tests for stored content.
4. Align BFF path/credential configuration across all ILS endpoints.
5. Verify service/repository tenant checks, idempotency, session semantics, concurrent writes and cross-user access.
6. Run automated and browser integration tests, then re-audit changed code before final Phase 04 acceptance.

**No code was changed; no builds, tests, deployments or data operations were run.**

## Positive architecture controls

1. Reviewed ILS mutation routes use `validateRequest(request, { requireInternalSecret: true })` and construct user/brand identity from the verified context.

3. `block-active-time/route.ts` uses client event ID and reports `processed` / `alreadyProcessed` for idempotent processing.
4. `learning-progress.hierarchy-resolution.ts` has a generic `progressRole` contract for instructional block requirements, excluding assessment/media/structural roles by default.
5. Dashboard data context verifies provider presence and fails clearly if used outside its provider.

# Phase 05 — Principal Architect Audit: Exams, Reporting, Exports and Reliability

**Repository:** skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC
**Commit:** `e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c` (`feature/project-llm-linux-worker`)
**Audit mode:** Read-only static inspection, plus dependency traces. No tests/builds/deployments or source changes.

## Executive decision

**Phase 05 audit assessment delivered; implementation deferred.** The identified defects are carried to the consolidated remediation backlog. This report does **not** claim exhaustive full-line certification of every monorepo exam/export implementation. Many larger service modules were reviewed via selected ranges rather than every source line; unexecuted runtime tests are also clearly excluded. Proceeding to Phase 06 is an audit-workflow decision, not a production sign-off.

## Files examined and boundaries

### SkillUp application

- `apps/skillup-web/src/app/sw.ts` — full source, 67 lines.
- `apps/skillup-web/next.config.mjs` — full source, 28 lines.
- `apps/skillup-web/src/app/exam/page.tsx`, `/exams/page.tsx`, `/result/page.tsx`, `/launch-exam/configure/page.tsx`, `/offline/page.tsx` — full source.
- `apps/skillup-web/src/app/api/quiz/{active,answer,count,result,start,state,submit}/route.ts` — 7 full route sources (all thin proxy wrappers).
- `src/share-branding/ExamEngine/components/examSessionLoader.ts`, `ExamEngine.tsx`, `ExamSummaryReport.tsx`, `launchExamPageData.ts` — retrieved; selected line ranges analyzed in detail.
- `src/share-branding/ExamLaunchPage.tsx`, `ExamLaunchConfigurationPage.tsx`, `ExamResultPage.tsx` — short sources retrieved.
- `src/share-branding/auth/authBffRoute.ts` — relevant forwarding/cookie ranges reviewed.

### API-server dependencies

- `apps/api-server/src/app/api/quiz/{state,submit,result}/route.ts` — routes retrieved, identity/ownership paths reviewed.
- `apps/api-server/src/app/api/export/{trigger,download}/route.ts` — routes retrieved; authorization-related paths reviewed.
- `apps/api-server/src/app/api/export/status/[jobId]/route.ts` — retrieved; authentication and response paths reviewed.

**Coverage restriction:** API job processors, export engine/saga, deep report and scoring services, full frontend accessibility and browser behavior are not fully line-by-line certified in this review. They belong to the final Phase 06 evidence closure and implementation test backlog.

## Findings

### PH05-001 | P1 | Offline cache may expose authenticated pages across sessions — confirmed code behavior

`apps/skillup-web/src/app/sw.ts` lines 29–65 intercepts all same-origin GET requests; on successful navigation responses it caches by request, and on fetch failure serves the cached response. It does not distinguish authenticated pages, tenant/user context, logout, or cache clearing. `next.config.mjs` enables Serwist in production with navigation caching. **Risk:** another browser user on the same profile could see stale private pages offline. **Action:** cache only public/static assets, remove protected navigation caching, and clear user-specific storage on logout.

### PH05-002 | P1 | Exam result UI substitutes fictional metrics — confirmed

`src/share-branding/ExamSummaryReport.tsx` lines 105–136 and 213–245 fallback to `12` correct answers, `76` percentile, `8/4/3` concept counts, 2025 date, hardcoded skills, and approximately 48 minutes when genuine metrics are missing. `||` also replaces legitimate zero values (`correctCount`, `percentile`, time). **Risk:** materially false academic results. **Action:** use `??` where zero is valid, null/unknown states, authoritative report fields and contract validation; never invent scores/dates.

### PH05-003 | P1/P2 | Export status endpoint lacks obvious user-to-job ownership check — confirmed inspection of route

`apps/api-server/src/app/api/export/status/[jobId]/route.ts` lines 81–116 verifies caller JWT or internal key and loads arbitrary job ID. Lines 118–246 emit status, errors, and potentially readiness/download response; no explicit `job.userId === userId` check was observed in that path. `resolveReadyExportArtifact` (around lines 265–304) accepts `job?.userId ?? requestUserId` for fallback lookup, which is **not** caller authorization. Compare download route's explicit job ownership check. **Risk:** cross-user export job metadata disclosure and state changes during recovery. **Action:** reject or return 404 on job ownership mismatch before any status/recovery logic, except narrowly authorized internal-service callers. Add cross-user tests.

### PH05-004 | P1/P2 | Export trigger does not clearly establish ownership of requested exam — confirmed route gap

`apps/api-server/src/app/api/export/trigger/route.ts` lines 29–68 takes the authenticated JWT user and client-specified `examId`, then invokes export processing. The route does not visibly query the exam's `userId` before enqueue. It is possible downstream export services enforce this; **this remains an unresolved dependency guarantee, not a proven exploit**. **Action:** explicit owner check at the route/service boundary and negative cross-user tests.

### PH05-005 | P2 | Exam timer is tied to client-rendered interval and may submit more than once — confirmed design risk

`src/share-branding/ExamEngine/components/ExamEngine.tsx` lines 50–73 counts down with a component interval, invokes `handleSubmit()` inside the state updater at expiry, and rebuilds the interval when remaining time changes. This clock can drift while backgrounded and the handler can race with explicit submission; IDs for retries are newly generated per action. **Action:** enforce server-side deadline and idempotent submission, use absolute deadline and one-shot `ref` guard, prevent unmounted requests.

### PH05-006 | P2 | Missing exam ID loads a demo session in production exam route — confirmed

`src/share-branding/ExamEngine/components/examSessionLoader.ts` lines 305–310 returns `demoExamApiResponse` when no `examId` supplied; `apps/skillup-web/src/app/exam/page.tsx` passes `examId` through without requiring a value. **Risk:** demo questions are presented under a real exam route. **Action:** separate explicit public demo URL from authenticated exam URL, reject missing exam IDs on production exam path.

### PH05-007 | P2 | Server-side session loader uses forwarded host/protocol in self-fetch — conditional

`examSessionLoader.ts` lines 279–302 selects `x-forwarded-host` before host, `x-forwarded-proto` before default, and calls that URL with the request's `cookie` header. If those headers can be injected from untrusted clients, this is an SSRF/credential-forwarding risk. Need actual ingress/proxy normalization tests to confirm exploitability. **Action:** prefer configured trusted internal origin; enforce allowlisted hostname and HTTPS, avoid forwarding user cookies to arbitrary hosts.

### PH05-008 | P2 | Quiz BFF wrappers rely on gateway/upstream for all authorization — integration dependency

The 7 `apps/skillup-web/src/app/api/quiz/*/route.ts` files only call `proxyUpstreamRequest`; identity and ownership depend on API server/gateway. API server `quiz/state` calls `SessionService.resumePayload(examId, payload.userId)`; `quiz/submit` calls `ExamEngine.completeExam(examId, payload.userId, ...)`; `quiz/result` explicitly compares `examCheck.userId` with token owner. These are positive checks. Verify full service-side behavior and audience/brand restrictions for each remaining quiz route.

### PH05-009 | P2 | Export status has side effects during GET polling — confirmed

`export/status/[jobId]/route.ts` lines ~118–154, ~204–221 may transition jobs to COMPLETED/FAILED based on polling time and recovered artifact. With incomplete authorization (PH05-003), these state changes are particularly concerning. **Action:** isolate reconciliation into authorized worker/maintenance process, use atomic transitions and clear GET read contract.

### PH05-010 | P2 | Accessibility and operational validation gap — not verified

Exam controls, timer announcements, accessible error feedback, keyboard navigation, focus recovery and reduced-motion behavior require browser audit. Service-worker offline downgrade and PWA lifecycle need real browser testing. Source inspection alone cannot certify WCAG conformance or resilience.

## Positive controls

- API quiz result route explicitly rejects exam IDs belonging to another user (`apps/api-server/src/app/api/quiz/result/route.ts` lines 37–47).
- API quiz state route uses verified access token and owner-scoped `resumePayload` call.
- API quiz submit passes authenticated owner to `completeExam` and supports idempotency keys.
- Export **download** route checks job owner / exam owner before fetching private artifacts (`apps/api-server/src/app/api/export/download/route.ts` lines 34–89).
- SkillUp quiz routes consistently centralize upstream forwarding rather than duplicating fetch logic.

## Remediation priority, **after all audits**

1. **P1:** Public-only service-worker caching, prohibit fake academic performance fields.
2. **P1/P2:** Export job owner authorization and explicit export trigger exam ownership checks; add negative integration tests.
3. **P2:** Server-driven exam deadlines/idempotency; separate demo mode; trusted self-fetch origin.
4. Validate queue job transitions, report scoring contracts, exam service ownership, and accessibility in CI/browser tests.

## Phase 05 audit disposition

**Audit workstream:** The principal architectural defects and integration boundaries are identified and documented. **No fixes implemented.** The report is suitable for the consolidated Phase 06 audit and remediation register.

**Not claimed:** All monorepo exam/export files completely read line by line; full API behavior proven by tests; production sign-off; absence of undiscovered defects.

**Next:** Phase 06 consolidated findings and audit evidence reconciliation. Do not condition the move on remediation, per user direction.

# SUIA — Consolidated Audit Continuation Report
**Scope:** `packages/marketing-site/src/` only
**Pinned commit:** `5efd1129d905d05c912acfef66e52df9ca15120b`
**Tree:** `a1753abdf166364bdc76c55df6ed33e1a014a8c4`

**Working rule:** Read-only. No remediation or implementation changes.

## Executive finding
The available audit evidence does **not** support a claim that every source file was exhaustively reviewed. The authenticated Git source inventory has 290 unique files. Phase 01 classifies 106 with earlier pinned-retrieval evidence, 45 with historical report mentions only, and 139 with no path-level evidence in the conservative ledger. Phase 02 documents 20 more complete-file inspections (1,113 lines), giving a conservative minimum of 126/290 pinned retrievals. These are retrieval counts, **not** certified line-by-line reviews. The Phase 02 report explicitly leaves 164 without proven pinned fetches in that snapshot.

## Work carried out in this continuation
Eight full source files were retrieved from the same pinned commit and their file SHA and source-line counts checked against specific integration concerns:

| File | Lines | Blob SHA | Audit evidence |
|---|---:|---|---|
| `components/CoursePages/Curriculum/useScrollDetection.tsx` | 26 | `698f45fef2ace58ff7b7a9e6e36f1d8bf89b7330` | Pinned file retrieved; targeted call-path verification |
| `components/CoursePages/Curriculum/mainCurriculum.tsx` | 78 | `b1cccd4872cea8c276b01dedc629b68591b45d98` | Pinned file retrieved; targeted call-path verification |
| `components/CoursePages/Assessments/FlipCard.tsx` | 47 | `d3f0868bb0f7005dac9aa7910b4522252897a3c4` | Pinned file retrieved; targeted call-path verification |
| `components/CoursePages/Assessments/CertificateShowcase.tsx` | 144 | `f48c2b02f8b49baa7da65c4a150832c6ada340ed` | Pinned file retrieved; targeted call-path verification |
| `lib/privacy/consent-storage.ts` | 30 | `0813c507ec4ac71d4f7465a682a5dfd36a90ae54` | Pinned file retrieved; targeted call-path verification |
| `lib/analytics/tracker.ts` | 308 | `c96245599587c049ec618f0733d3758d4286241a` | Pinned file retrieved; targeted call-path verification |
| `components/privacy/ConsentBanner.tsx` | 53 | `9cf1a7a95ec1dd47af7b5e25bcdf49de16bd68d2` | Pinned file retrieved; targeted call-path verification |
| `lib/analytics/identity/user-merge-engine.ts` | 58 | `52aac76bcb60be1d8a9c498b99e2052cf696a37e` | Pinned file retrieved; targeted call-path verification |

### Revalidated source-level defects
1. **Analytics single-brand singleton:** `lib/analytics/tracker.ts:197–229` declares one `trackerSingleton` and initializes it using only the first requested brand. A second brand may reuse another brand’s provider configuration in a shared module runtime. This is P03-02 / RC-02.
2. **Consent-gate bypass in direct methods:** `lib/analytics/tracker.ts:109–133` calls `identifyUser`, `setUserProperties`, and `trackPageView` without `canDispatchProvider`; only `flush()` at lines 145–152 checks consent. This is P03-07 / RC-01.
3. **Identity conflicts not aborting merge:** `lib/analytics/identity/user-merge-engine.ts:19–45` accumulates conflicts then saves the merged record regardless. This is P03-04 / RC-04.
4. **Unvalidated consent storage:** `lib/privacy/consent-storage.ts:10–27` reads localStorage outside the `try` block, casts arbitrary parsed JSON to `ConsentState`, and writes without a catch. This is P03-05 / RC-05.
5. **Inaccessible card interaction:** `components/CoursePages/Assessments/FlipCard.tsx:33–46` attaches onClick to a `div` without keyboard activation/role/focus behavior. Previously described in the Phase 02 audit; retain as existing observation, not a new ticket.
6. **Curriculum target requires caller verification:** `useScrollDetection.tsx:8` requires the exact element ID `CourseCurriculum`; `mainCurriculum.tsx:39–40` provides `learning-path` on the wrapper and a caller-provided inner `id`. Missing button behavior is conditional on the caller passing a different ID; do not call it unconditional without verifying the caller.

### Controls already evaluated elsewhere
- P03-01 trusted consent at ingestion endpoint; P03-03 and P03-08 event-delivery success/acknowledgement; P03-06 preference reopening mechanism are documented in Phase 03.
- Phase 04 crosswalk groups P03-01–08 in six root-cause families. The underlying 286 historical MKT IDs **cannot** be individually deduplicated or marked fixed from available source-of-truth records.
- Phase 05 release-gate register identifies 11 gates. It is not evidence that these gates passed.

## Sequential completion protocol — no implementation
1. **Finish source review evidence:** for each of the 290 paths, record exact blob SHA, complete source reading, relevant dependencies, a code-level conclusion, and existing/new finding mapping. Use the accompanying 290-row ledger. Do not equate fetch to exhaustive semantic review.
2. **Reconcile the canonical defect register:** obtain individual MKT-001–286 details where absent, map each to root cause and current pinned-source behavior, and distinguish confirmed/conditional/duplicate/superseded.
3. **Integration/security audit:** complete cross-file traces for consent, analytics, provider dispatch, identity, event bus, lead capture, certificates, curriculum and navigation. Identify tests required; do not claim execution.
4. **Final read-only report:** publish evidence-backed risk register and an explicit statement of pass/fail/untested gate status. Leave implementation to the separate follow-on workstream.

## Blocking evidence limitations
- No local working copy or authenticated full source tree is mounted in this runtime. A Git connector can fetch individual files, but the historical report does not certify review semantics on the other files.
- No executable build, CI runtime, browser, provider, or environment tests were performed.
- No canonical itemized MKT-001–286 remediation/closure register was supplied.
- Consequently the completed-file percentage, current unique unresolved-defect count, and production sign-off cannot honestly be asserted.

**Decision:** Audit work performed and consolidated; **complete audit certificate withheld**. This is not an implementation report and makes no source changes.

# SkillUp IT Academy — Consolidated Principal Architect Source Audit

**Audit snapshot:** 2026-11-01
**Repository:** `skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC`
**Pinned source commit:** `e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c` (feature branch `feature/project-llm-linux-worker`)
**Audit mode:** read-only; no changes, builds, automated tests, deployments, penetration tests, load tests, or cloud-state validation were performed in this review.
**Status:** **Consolidated source-assessment delivered. Exhaustive code-by-code certification NOT substantiated. Production sign-off NOT granted.**

## Executive statement

This file consolidates all **five supplied phase reports**, the Phase 01 inventory, and the architecture/audit project reference material. It is the unified assessment and actionable post-audit implementation backlog. The source audit identifies serious defects in session ownership, identity consistency, client-facing learner data, tutorial progress, offline caching, assessment reports, and exports. Findings remain open for future implementation. Not all 110 SkillUp source files have proven whole-file review and the full dependency closure is not documented; it would be inaccurate to mark those tasks finished just to satisfy a request for 100% completion.

### Verified inventory basis

- **110** TypeScript/JavaScript files under `apps/skillup-web/src` at the pinned commit, per Phase 01 tree inventory.
- **410** shared-branding TS/JS source files exist in the same tree; only relevant subsets were examined, not all 410 files.
- **46** unique finding IDs carried from Phases 02–05 (12 + 15 + 9 + 10), **not** 46 verified independent root causes: overlap and common upstream ownership are explicitly grouped below.
- Inventory evidence categories: Prior targeted/partial evidence; needs full-range closure: 48, Complete-source retrieved previously; review depth not revalidated: 58, No adequate line-by-line evidence in current audit history: 4. A file retrieved in full is **not automatically** a verified complete line-by-line review.

## Consolidated risk order and deduplication

| Priority | Root-cause group | Phase finding references | Remediation and acceptance evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| P0/P1 | User/session authorization boundary | P02-009, P02-010, P02-002, PH04-001, PH05-003, PH05-004 | Require `userId` ownership on every session revoke; reject explicit invalid internal/gateway auth rather than downshift; verify ownership before export triggering and status retrieval; authenticate all tutorial progress requests. Add cross-user negative tests. |
| P1 | Canonical identity / brand contracts | P02-001, P02-011, P02-012, P02-005, PH04-004, PH04-005 | Define brand-local vs global ID contracts and source of user ID; strip caller-provided privileged headers at boundaries; reject unresolved brands; test each brand, identity, and service route. |
| P1 | Fabricated educational and financial state | PH03-001/002/003/006/010/015, PH05-002, PH05-006 | Remove production fixture substitutions; use empty/error states; render only persisted grades, percentile, attendance, placement and recording availability. Add no-data/error/zero-score tests. |
| P1 | Private offline data and token transfer | PH05-001, P02-003, P02-006 | Prevent caching authenticated HTML/RSC; clear caches on logout/account switch; scope and rotate one-time placement handoff tokens; validate cookie domain and host trust. |
| P1/P2 | Tutorial renderer / progress consistency | PH04-002/003/006/007/008/009 | Confirm content sanitization; unify navigation progress; distinguish delivery vs persistence; verify hierarchy authorization and repeated/competing event behavior. |
| P2 | Lifecycle and billing consistency | PH03-004/005/007/008/009/011/012/013/014 | Fix enrollment and attendance denominators, payment source of truth, onboarding failure routing, access control on persisted journey hints, UI controls and semantic table keys. |
| P2 | Exam and export operation lifecycle | PH05-005/007/008/009/010 | Enforce server-authoritative deadline and idempotent submit, trusted SSR origin resolution, consistent upstream ownership; make export status read-only or document reaper state machine; run accessibility/performance tests. |

**Severity note:** P0/P1 denotes implementation urgency after validation, not a claim of an independently reproduced exploit. All claims must be read with the original finding's confirmed/conditional qualifier preserved in the appended reports.

## Audit checklist / closure decisions

| Gate | Evidence-backed conclusion |
|---|---|
| Repository and SkillUp source inventory | **PASS for file enumeration:** pinned tree not truncated, 110 source/test files inventoried. |
| Security source-path review | **Source findings consolidated**, but full dependent-route verification and negative authorization tests not completed. |
| Student / academic lifecycle review | **Main workflows assessed**, but downstream ownership and complete-file evidence still outstanding. |
| Tutorial V2 and ILS | **Main frontend-to-API paths assessed**, large service/repository implementations only selectively analyzed. |
| Exam, export and reliability | **Main pathways assessed**, no actual browser, accessibility, offline isolation, queue-failure, load or recovery tests. |
| Entire 110-file line-by-line audit | **NOT VERIFIED**: existing inventory flags files as prior full retrieval or partial, not line-certified. |
| All referenced shared modules line-by-line | **NOT VERIFIED**: dependency closure across `src/share-branding`, `packages/auth`, `packages/db-*`, `packages/ui`, gateway, queue, and storage is incomplete. |
| Production-release readiness | **NOT APPROVED** due to open high-impact findings and absence of runtime proof. |

**Architectural disposition:** The five phase **finding assessments have been consolidated** into one final report, and it is appropriate to proceed to planning fixes without new phase-by-phase report ceremony. However, **a claim of 'total audit complete with nothing pending' cannot be supported** by source evidence currently available. To close a strict complete-line audit, enumerate and read all 110 files in full with line-range signoffs, trace every imported security-critical dependency, review database predicates/schema and cross-tenant boundaries, and provide executed tests/deployment evidence separately. No remediation was performed, as requested.

## Single implementation backlog (post-audit; no changes made)

1. **Authorization hotfixes:** Pass owner ID to `revokeById`; require owner match without optional bypass. Require export job/exam ownership before status and trigger side effects. Require verified identity for legacy tutorial progress. Add cross-user tests.
2. **Trust-boundary unification:** Normalize user IDs and brands, remove request-provided internal identity assertions, validate all privileged authentication errors as final, lock down fixture session issuance and placement token exchange.
3. **No fabricated data:** Replace fallbacks in student batch/program/faculty/placement and exam performance; represent zero values with nullish checks rather than `||`; remove constructed recording URLs and fake defaults.
4. **Privacy-first offline:** Restrict cache to versioned public static assets, purge on logout, test switch-user/offline behavior. Verify production Serwist generated service worker rules as well as source worker.
5. **Tutorial consistency:** Align legacy and ILS APIs, one authoritative progress model, validated content HTML, hierarchy and ownership checks; confirm idempotency under concurrent events.
6. **Exam/report reliability:** Enforce deadline server-side, idempotent final submission, ensure exam result and export state machines handle retries, missing artifacts and secure download.
7. **Quality gates:** Execute deterministic unit and integration tests, security negatives, tenant isolation, UI accessibility, offline/browser tests, migration checks and performance suites **after** changes are authorized.

# SkillUp-Web — Phase 01 Inventory and Audit Reconciliation Report

**Date:** 1 November 2026
**Repository:** `skillupitacademy-alt/SUIA_RTH_SHC`
**Branch:** `feature/project-llm-linux-worker`
**Pinned commit:** `e1b26a9e0e4feb0da38adf400e94dc911f495b2c`
